subject: Executive roundtable — guest curation & venue contract
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@the-atelier-sf.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Executive roundtable — guest curation & venue contract

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're moving ahead with the private executive roundtable at The Atelier on Sept 10 (evening). A few asks to finalize by end of day Tuesday so we can circulate invites: 

- Final contract and standard venue terms (we prefer DocuSign). Can you include the private dining room addendum and AV rider?
- Final plated sample menu and any plated tasting options (we have 2 guests with strict dietary restrictions).
- Confirmation you can support two separate discrete arrival windows for LPs (6:00–6:15 and 6:30–6:45) for staggered check-in.
- A short vendor NDA or confirmation you accept our attached Redwood Event NDAs (we may need signed copies for two finance-sensitive guests).
- Estimate for total event cost (venue + food + service + AV + 20% service/fees). We have budget authority up to $6k without exec sign-off.

Attached: placeholder for Redwood_Event_NDAs.pdf (will upload actual soon).

Also looping Laura and Marissa from Field Marketing to confirm final guest curation. High-level guest list will be ~10 external LPs + 2 internal hosts. Two priority external guests from Northbridge Capital (names below).

Thanks — if you can send the proposal and DocuSign link today that'd be ideal.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
(jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com)

From: Elena Morales <elena@the-atelier-sf.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-08-15T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable — guest curation & venue contract

Hi Jasmine — great to talk earlier.

Attaching the venue proposal and sample menu for your review: Venue_Proposal_Atelier_081526.pdf, Catering_Sample_Menu.pdf. We can accommodate two arrival waves in the private dining room and will keep the entrance discrete for invited LPs.

We host a number of closed-door investor dinners and are comfortable with limited guest lists and signed NDAs. If you prefer, we can sign Redwood's event NDA (please send final) — otherwise we can provide our standard vendor terms.

DocuSign link for the current proposal and terms: https://docusign.net/Redwood-Atelier-0815/abcdef

Notes:
- Menu: we can do a two-course plated dinner + one dessert course; vegetarian and pescatarian options available.
- AV: small lav mic + discreet projection (no stage) — included in estimate.
- Service fee: 20% included.

We will hold the space provisionally for you through Friday (8/20) on a tentative deposit. Please let us know headcount and any required vendor paperwork.

Best,
Elena Morales
Events Director, The Atelier
elena@the-atelier-sf.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Elena Morales <elena@the-atelier-sf.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-08-15T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable — guest curation & venue contract

On Aug 15, 2026, at 1:45 PM, Elena Morales <elena@the-atelier-sf.com> wrote:
> Attaching the venue proposal and sample menu for your review...

Thanks Elena — proposal looks clean. Quick updates from guest curation side (attaching exec_roundtable_guests_v2.csv):

- Priority externals (please note compliance flags):
  - Mike Chen, Northbridge Capital (partner) — dietary: pescatarian
  - Laura Vega, Northbridge Capital (investment director) — dietary: vegetarian
- We're capping the external guest list at 10 (plus 2 internal hosts). Please mark these two as requiring basic vendor NDAs (they prefer firms' privacy screens).
- Please add a note to the contract referencing our name usage and no-recording clause (no photos or audio).
- AV: request two clip-on mics (for two short remarks) and no live streaming.

Also: we have 3 guests with nut allergies and 1 with gluten intolerance — please confirm cross-contamination procedures in catering notes.

If legal needs the venue to sign Redwood_Event_NDAs.pdf, I'll route it to Legal. Otherwise ask Elena to countersign via DocuSign.

Thanks — Laura
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Elena Morales <elena@the-atelier-sf.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-08-15T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable — guest curation & venue contract

Thanks Laura / Elena — all helpful. Quick next steps: 

1) Elena — can you push the DocuSign envelope to include the no-recording clause and the two arrival windows? Once signed we'll release the deposit.
2) Laura — thanks for the guest CSV — I'll send invites once contract is signed. Please highlight any redlines for Legal.
3) Marcus — pinging for budget approval (cc'd) — we estimate ~$5.6k all-in per Elena's PDF. Jasmine, Marissa, Vivek will coordinate final logistics.

Attaching Redwood_Event_NDAs.pdf for your legal team (attached separately).

Best,
Jasmine

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-08-15T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive roundtable — guest curation & venue contract

Looks good to me. Approve up to $6,000 for venue + catering + AV. Finance: please proceed with PO once DocuSign is complete and deposit invoice is issued.

-Marcus
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
